pages.title: Read the mana budget
pages.text: The standard state anchors default parameters and preparation time. Shape volume, spell power, base mana cost, equipment reduction and charge determine output cost; link, rune and storage losses are accounted separately.

Spell power increases damage and demand through the cost exponent. Base cost and reduction are separate player attributes. Cheaper output does not shrink fixed input; eligible surplus follows source-ledger refunds.
